newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver leaps near close but gold becalmed.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver leaps near close but gold becalmed.

text.p: Silver prices opened distinctly higher on the back of an overnight spurt in the world market and limited arrivals helped the market extend gains towards the close, dealers said.
Silver was down 80 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
"Physical buying by industrial consumers remained low today but heavy speculative activity following an upsurge in the world market dragged prices to dizzy heights," one broker said.
"Such a big jump in a single day has been seen after a long time in the silver market," he added. Silver prices in the world market has gone up from 4.83 dollars to 5.15 dollars per ounce.
